Priya Nair: Heads-up: onboarding hiccup with the new next-eval-edge starter (LangChain + LlamaIndex + eval harness). Followed README, set REDWOOD_API_KEY, but after deploy to Vercel the edge eval job intermittently fails with 401s and the SDK doesn't retry. Eval runner reports partial results and the harness marks tests flaky. Anyone seen the edge + token rotation combo? cc @Ethan

Ethan Brooks: Are you using a project key or ephemeral session? Edge functions often live longer and may reuse module-scope clients. If infra rotates keys we should see x-rw-exp on upstream responses. The JS SDK should retry on 429/5xx but historically skipped auth refresh parity.

Priya Nair: Project key for staging. Minimal repro from the eval harness worker:
```js
// worker/eval-runner.js (edge)
import { createClient } from '@redwood/sdk-js'
const client = createClient(process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY)
export async function runEval(prompt) {
  return client.evaluate({ model: 'redwood/eval-mini', prompt })
}
```

Priya Nair: Staging logs show: 
```
2026-03-21T19:04:12Z WARN upstream 401 x-rw-error=invalid_api_key x-rw-exp=63
2026-03-21T19:04:12Z ERROR eval-runner unhandled -> partial-result
```

Liying Zhou: This is similar to other starter issues but with an edge twist: the eval harness opens multiple concurrent lightweight workers and some of them see rotated keys mid-run. We need JS SDK parity for token refresh and also better error shaping so the harness can mark a run as retriable instead of flaky.

Marco Li: Quick mitigation: change the starter to create the client inside the runEval invocation (avoid module scope) and add a tiny preflight ping before heavy evals: `await client.ping()` and inspect x-rw-exp. If expiry < now+20s recreate client. That prevents mid-run 401s for the majority of cases. Also update the harness to treat auth-related failures as retryable.

Ethan Brooks: Agreed. I'll sketch a small PR in sdk-js to implement: (1) on 401 + x-rw-exp <= now+15s do a single auth refresh + retry, (2) normalize non-2xx to throw an Error object with status/headers so the harness can decide. Include unit + an e2e that simulates short-lived keys.

Priya Nair: For the harness we should also add a dedupe/idempotency token so retries don't double-count eval metrics. Right now partial responses make the test harness mark results inconsistent.

DevOps Bot: CI triggered: workflow/devex-eval-edge-smoke for branch fix/sdk-edge-auth (run 1/1) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Marco Li: Small starter README patch: recommend creating client per-invocation for edge runtimes, add eval-harness note to treat 401+rotation as retriable, and add a sample preflight snippet. Pushed docs to examples/edge-auth-notes.md.

Ethan Brooks: Draft PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/1023  implements single retry-on-rotation + error normalization for JS. Tests include simulated short-lived keys and a tiny eval-runner integration test.

Priya Nair: After merging staging deploy, re-ran harness: flaky count dropped to 0/50 runs. Verified preflight + per-request client in the starter fixed the issue for our edge evals. Thanks all!

Liying Zhou: Follow-up: open ticket DX-EVAL-304 to track full streaming/eval parity and idempotency token support for retry-safe eval replays. Assigning to Ethan+Marco.

Priya Nair: Adding the repro and notes to the starter repo under docs/auth-rotation-edge.md. Will monitor telemetry. :thumbsup:
